messages:
sam: Morning folks, brand new hire here. My Okta enroll link bounced with 'SMS not deliverable'. I'm on Vodafone UK +44 7700 900000. Also 1Password invite shows expired even though HR said it was sent today. Who's the right person to ping?
it-help: Hi @sam welcome! We sometimes see Vodafone drop short codes. Quick ask: did you try the "resend as voice call" option on the Okta page?
sam: Tried that, the call never came. I did get a push attempt earlier but it failed because I hadn't finished SSO.
lina: I can check provisioning. @sam can you confirm the email used and your employee badge number?
sam: sam@redwood.com, badge 4312.
devops: I see your entry in the provisioning queue but it failed at the SMS gateway step (carrier reject). Working with the gateway team now. We can open a temporary WebAuthn passkey for you to finish SSO in the meantime.
sam: That'd be great, thanks. Also 1Password shows 'Invite expired' even though people-ops said seat allocated.
people-ops: @lina we approved a seat for Sam earlier this morning. Can IT resend from the 1Password admin console?
lina: Confirmed seat allocation in HR side. @it-help please resend 1Password invite to sam@redwood.com and toggle 'resend as admin' if needed.
it-help: Resent from admin console. 1Password-bot should show it.
1password-bot: 1Password: Admin invite sent to sam@redwood.com (admin resend). Expires in 7 days.
sam: Got the 1Password link, able to create account. Okta still failing SMS though.
okta-bot: Okta: SMS gateway returned 403 for number +447700900000 (carrier reject). Escalating to gateway provider.
devops: In the interim I've opened a temporary WebAuthn token for sam that expires in 24h. Sam, try enrolling with passkey now.
sam: Passkey enrollment worked! SSO with Google completed. Thanks all. One more question: will a hardware YubiKey still be shipped or is passkey preferred?
people-ops: We ship YubiKeys by default; passkeys are supported but we still mail a YubiKey for physical backup. ETA 3-5 business days.
sam: Awesome, appreciate the smooth onboarding help :smile:
